(version 1)

;; Permissive base — deny specific operations below.
(allow default)

;; Deny all writes by default.
(deny file-write*)

;; Node.js runtime always-writable paths.
(allow file-write*
  (literal "/dev/null")
  (literal "/dev/zero")
  (literal "/dev/random")
  (literal "/dev/urandom")
  (regex #"^/dev/fd/[0-9]+$")
  (subpath "/private/var/folders")
  (subpath "/var/folders") (subpath "/private/var/folders")
  (subpath "/private/tmp")
  (subpath "/tmp") (subpath "/private/tmp")
)

;; Sub-agent workspace.
(allow file-write* (subpath "/Users/yumx/code/Beyondminic-Weilai-X1"))

;; Caller-specified extra write paths.
(allow file-write*
  (subpath "/Users/yumx/.account-pool")
  (subpath "/Users/yumx/.config/gh")
  (subpath "/private/var/folders/3r/gk4flgtj3d7d30y1h95dmwxh0000gn/C/mds")
  (subpath "/Users/yumx/code/Beyondminic-Weilai-X1")
)

;; Caller-specified write-deny paths (override allows above).
(deny file-write*
  (subpath "/Users/yumx/code/Beyondminic-Weilai-X1/.meta-agent")
  (subpath "/Users/yumx/.meta-agent")
)
